I0002.statement: settings secret masking must recurse into dict/list values
I0002.why: VR-P02: accounts[].password leaked raw on effective endpoints

I0003.statement: IP safety classifier must use ipaddress.is_global as the allowlist test

I0004.statement: numeric validators must reject non-finite (NaN/inf) before range checks
I0004.why: VR-P08/P12: NaN evaded bounds -> live-config corruption; inf -> 500

I0005.statement: every /cockpit/api/ write the cockpit issues must send a CSRF token
I0005.why: v3.66.532: api() sent an empty token after the 531 gate covered /cockpit/api/

I0006.statement: the global CSRF/origin guard must cover /api/ and /cockpit/api/
I0006.why: PHC-1 B1: 28 cockpit writes were auth-gated but CSRF-unguarded

I0007.statement: apprise .add() must pass tag= when notify() filters on tag
I0007.why: VR-P01: untagged add() -> notify(tag=event) matched 0 services

I0008.statement: the KV secret-keyword set must equal or consult the URL-query SoT
I0008.why: VR-P03: narrower KV set let OAuth #code=/otp= survive the floor

I0009.statement: user-controlled SQL identifiers (table/column) must be allowlisted
I0009.why: VR-P10: f-string table interpolation from request body

I0010.statement: redaction scanner must fail-closed on non-dict/list/str leaves (bytes/set)
I0010.why: VR-THD: scanner passed bytes/set through unscanned (fail-open)

I-CAP01-rec-url-shape.statement: Any url stored in a live_recorder Recording must be entry-validated to ^https?://...$ before it can reach a subprocess argv. Both population paths (watch() and _load_state() rehydration) must enforce it; _is_room_live relies on this invariant rather than re-validating.
